test_title: RRB NTPC (UG) CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 29 Aug, 2025 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a private sector organisation in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**TISCO**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **TISCO** (Tata Iron and Steel Company Limited), now known as **Tata Steel Limited**, is a private sector organization in India. It was established in **1907** by the Tata Group and is one of the largest steel-producing companies in the world.
 
• Being part of the private sector, TISCO is owned and managed by private entities, specifically the **Tata Group**, which is a well-known conglomerate in India. Hence, it is distinct from public sector undertakings that are owned and operated by the government.
 
• **SAIL** (Steel Authority of India Limited), **ONGC** (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation), and **Indian Railways** are **public sector organizations**. They are either government-owned or controlled and fall under the direct administrative purview of the Government of India.
 
• **SAIL** is a public sector company under the Ministry of Steel, while **ONGC** functions under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas. **Indian Railways** is a government department under the Ministry of Railways and is entirely state-owned. Hence, these organizations are not private sector entities.
 
• The private sector in India comprises businesses that are owned and operated by individuals or private organizations, as opposed to the public sector, which is state-controlled. **TISCO** is a classic example of a private sector organization in India.
 
• *Thus, the correct answer is TISCO.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **About TISCO (Tata Steel Limited):**

 
 
• **Founded:** **1907** in Jamshedpur, Jharkhand.
 
• **Founder:** **Jamsetji Tata**, a visionary industrialist.
 
• **Operations:** Tata Steel is one of the largest steel-producing companies globally. It operates in **26 countries** and has a commercial presence in over **50 countries**.
 
• **Significance:** It is one of the first private companies in India to establish a large-scale industrial setup.
 
• **Features:** Known for its sustainable practices, Tata Steel focuses on innovation, technology, and corporate social responsibility.
 
 
 
• **About SAIL (Steel Authority of India Limited):**
 
 
• **Founded:** 1973, headquartered in New Delhi.
 
• **Type:** Public Sector Undertaking (PSU) under the Ministry of Steel.
 
• **Functions:** Engaged in the production and marketing of steel and related products. It is one of the largest steel-making companies in India.
 
 
 
• **About ONGC (Oil and Natural Gas Corporation):**
 
 
• **Founded:** 1956, headquartered in Dehradun, Uttarakhand.
 
• **Type:** Public Sector Undertaking under the Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas.
 
• **Functions:** Responsible for exploration, production, and distribution of oil and natural gas. It is a significant contributor to India's energy needs.
 
 
 
• **About Indian Railways:**
 
 
• **Established:** **1853**, with the first train running between Mumbai and Thane.
 
• **Type:** A Government of India entity under the Ministry of Railways.
 
• **Significance:** One of the largest rail networks in the world, Indian Railways serves millions of passengers daily and is essential for freight movement.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

 
• **Private vs Public Sector:**

 
 
• The **private sector** is run by private individuals or companies, focusing on profit generation, innovation, and competitive practices. Examples include **Tata Steel, Reliance Industries, and Infosys.**
 
• The **public sector**, on the other hand, is government-owned and operates to serve public interests, focusing on essential services and development. Examples include **SAIL, ONGC, and Indian Railways**.
 
 
 
• **Tata Group:**
 
 
• A renowned Indian conglomerate with global reach, founded in **1868**.
 
• It operates in diverse industries such as steel, automotive, hospitality, technology, and more.
 
• Known for its contributions to India's industrial development.
